title: The Infisical vault is the grant
objective: A name present in Infisical project cursor-governance prod / is authorized for Cursor and Claude to bind when the task needs that system. The committed allow-list matches the vault. Agents see the name catalog at session start and are not asked to wait for a reminder. Values are never printed, exported, or written into mcp.json.
success_criteria: V1 passes: capability_bind allows every name in the vault-list fixture, including AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET, GITHUB_CLASSIC_PAT, L9_MEMORY_NEO4J_URI, and VANILLASOFT_API, and refuses CLAUDE_INFISICAL_CLIENT_SECRET
V2 passes: operator_only_iam --check exits 0 with an empty operator_only_keys list and no hosted forbid privilege required
V3 passes: the session report lists PERPLEXITY_API_KEY as an authorized name and the report text contains no secret value
V4 passes: the changed-file catalog in .pre-commit-config.yaml exits 0

in: Sync root_env_keys to the live prod / names and accept a live listing as authorization even when the committed list is stale
Remove the operator-only bind refusal and the hosted IAM forbid on AUTH0_CLIENT_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID, and AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET
Publish the authorized name catalog from one viewSecretValue=false list at SessionStart
Append the grant rule to skills/l9-secrets/SKILL.md and AGENTS.md
Spawn vault-named MCP servers through a child-env bind so N8N_API_KEY, NOTION_API_KEY, PERPLEXITY_API_KEY, SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN, and GITHUB_TOKEN are usable without a second copy of the value
out: Creating FIRECRAWL_API_KEY or TAVILY_MCP_URL; those names are not in the vault and are not a grant
hydrate --export, printing values, or writing values into mcp.json, receipts, or chat
Rewriting CANONICAL_LAW.md; GITHUB_TOKEN stays the default GitHub credential
Making make pr require SONAR_TOKEN or SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN
Implementing this change on the dirty feat/pr-review-permission checkout

todos.task: Make the live prod / listing the allow-list. Mirror those names into root_env_keys, union a viewSecretValue=false list into allowed_names so a new vault name is authorized before the next commit, and add CLAUDE_INFISICAL_CLIENT_SECRET to REFUSED_NAMES beside the other machine-identity secrets. Drop L9_MEMORY_HOOK_CLIENT_ID and L9_MEMORY_HOOK_CLIENT_SECRET from the committed mirror because they are not in the vault; the live list authorizes them on the day they appear. Register AUTH0_CLIENT_NAME, GITHUB_CLASSIC_PAT, L9_MEMORY_NEO4J_URI, L9_MEMORY_NEO4J_USER, L9_MEMORY_NEO4J_PASSWORD, L9_STATE_MONGO_URI, MONGODB_ATLAS_CLIENT_ID, MONGODB_ATLAS_CLIENT_SECRET, and VANILLASOFT_API.

Remove the operator-only bind refusal and the hosted IAM forbid. Empty operator_only_keys. operator_only_iam.py --check passes when the forbid privilege is absent, and --apply deletes it. AUTH0_CLIENT_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID, and AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET bind on Cursor and Claude. Values stay in-process.

Publish the authorized name catalog from that one list at SessionStart. The runtime report names every non-refused vault key and states that a listed name is authorized to bind when the task needs that system. Do not fetch values and do not add ninety individual binds. Append the same rule to skills/l9-secrets/SKILL.md and an AGENTS.md fragment. GITHUB_TOKEN remains the default GitHub credential; GITHUB_CLASSIC_PAT is bindable when the task needs that credential. Do not rewrite the make-pr sentence that says SONAR_TOKEN and SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN are not required.

Cover PERPLEXITY_API_KEY, NOTION_API_KEY, N8N_API_KEY, N8N_API_URL, SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN, and GITHUB_TOKEN mapped onto GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN. The wrapper binds into the child environment only. master.mcp.json and the rendered Cursor config keep placeholders and never receive values. Leave FIRECRAWL_API_KEY and TAVILY_MCP_URL unwired.

stress_test.blast_radius: Cursor and Claude can bind every non-refused prod / secret, including the Auth0 Memory admin client and GITHUB_CLASSIC_PAT. A bug in the MCP child environment can expose one bound value to that child process. The session report can leak a value only if the list call requests values.

risks.risk: Claude can bind the Auth0 client that administers the Memory tenant
risks.mitigation: Bind stays in-process. The session catalog prints names only. Rollback restores the forbid privilege with operator_only_iam.py --apply.

risks.risk: The live-list union authorizes a newly created vault name with no review commit
risks.mitigation: That is the operator rule. The committed mirror is still updated in the same change so review sees today's names, and REFUSED_NAMES still blocks the identity secrets.

risks.risk: The hook carrier expects L9_MEMORY_HOOK_CLIENT_ID and L9_MEMORY_HOOK_CLIENT_SECRET, which are not in the vault
risks.mitigation: Drop them from the committed mirror and leave the carrier calling bind. It stays unbound until those names exist in the vault, at which point the live list authorizes them.

unknowns.decision_effect: If --apply cannot delete it, Claude bind of the Auth0 names still fails at Infisical after the repo refusal is gone.
